ov: Two New World vultures, the largest flying land birds in the Western Hemisphere: the Andean condor of the Andes and the California condor of the western US and Mexico. The Andean condor is often called the largest bird of prey in the world.
rg: The Andes and Pacific coast of western South America; the mountains of California, Arizona and northern Mexico.

cf.tip: Condors are New World vultures, the largest ones. The Old World vultures of Africa, Asia and Europe look similar but aren’t closely related.

fx: An Andean condor’s bare head flushes and changes colour with its mood.
